summary.text: Paul McDaniel is the Independent Party candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 30-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Kristine Reeves.
McDaniel advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 36.3% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: McDaniel previously ran in the August 2, 2022 primary for Washington House of Representatives District 30-Position 1 as a Republican, receiving 11.4% of the vote and not advancing to the general election.
